layout.description: Manage members, workouts, assignments and progress from one modern platform designed for high-performance facilities.

login.title: Welcome Back
login.subtitle: Sign in to access your workspace and continue managing your training with confidence.

register.athleteSubtitle: Join the platform built for performance and start managing your training with confidence.
register.coachSubtitle: Join STREN as an independent coach to program workouts, manage athletes, and track progress.

forgotPassword.title: Reset Your Password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter the email address associated with your STREN account to receive password reset instructions.

verifyResetCode.title: Enter Recovery Code
verifyResetCode.subtitle: Please enter the 6-digit password reset code sent to {{email}}.
verifyResetCode.toastRequired: Please enter both your email address and 6-digit code.
verifyResetCode.devNoticeTitle: Development Notice: Real email delivery is disabled
verifyResetCode.devNoticeBody: EMAIL_PROVIDER=console is active in backend/.env. No external email was sent to your inbox. Configure Resend or SMTP to deliver real emails.
verifyResetCode.deliveryIssueDefault: The email provider encountered an error while attempting delivery. Please check backend settings or click Resend.
verifyResetCode.deliverySuccessAccepted: Accepted by {{provider}}{{idInfo}}. Please check your inbox and spam folder.

resetPassword.title: Create New Password
resetPassword.subtitleDefault: Enter a strong, secure password for your STREN account.
resetPassword.successDescription: Your password has been successfully updated. All previous active sessions have been securely terminated.
resetPassword.toastMissingToken: Missing or expired reset token. Please request a new recovery code.
resetPassword.toastMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters long.
resetPassword.toastFailed: Password reset failed. Please restart the request.

verifyEmail.title: Verify Your Email
verifyEmail.subtitle: We've sent a 6-digit verification code to your email. Enter the code below to complete registration and unlock your STREN account.
verifyEmail.codeExpires: Code expires in 10 minutes. Check your spam or promotions folder if not received.
verifyEmail.errorRequired: Please enter both your email address and 6-digit verification code.
verifyEmail.errorDigits: Verification code must be exactly 6 digits.
verifyEmail.errorResendEmailRequired: Please enter your email address to receive a verification code.
verifyEmail.toastResendSuccess: A new verification code has been sent.
verifyEmail.errorFailedFallback: Verification failed. Please check your code and try again.
verifyEmail.errorResendFallback: Failed to resend verification code. Please try again later.

google.scriptFailed: Google Identity Services failed to load. Check ad blocker or network settings.
google.loadError: Could not load Google authentication script. Please check your network or ad blocker.

validation.nameMinLength: Name must be at least 3 characters
validation.passwordMinLength: Password must be at least 8 characters
